prompt: Fatima phoned Declan about her broken garden door. She asked whether he (can / to fix) it on Saturday. Declan promised (to come) early in the morning. Then he told her (not / to worry) about the lock.
explanation_ru: В вопросе can сдвигается в could, после promise идёт to-инфинитив, а отрицательная просьба строится с not перед to.

prompt: My mum called Ewan from the supermarket. She asked if he (to clean) the balcony at that moment. Ewan replied that he (will / to wash) the plastic chairs next. Mum thanked him and hung up.
explanation_ru: Действие в момент речи (Present Continuous) сдвигается в Past Continuous (was cleaning), а will переходит в would.

prompt: Grandad sent Lara a quick message during his trip. He asked whether she (to water) the roses yet. Lara answered that she (to finish) ten minutes earlier. Grandad told her (to lock) the garden shed afterwards.
explanation_ru: Present Perfect и Past Simple сдвигаются в Past Perfect (had watered, had finished), а указание после tell передаётся через to-инфинитив.

prompt: Gabe met Julia after lunch on Tuesday. He asked her what time (her class / to begin). Julia explained that the teacher (to move) it to five o'clock. Gabe offered (to walk) her to the school gate.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе порядок слов прямой и без did (her class began), предшествующее изменение уходит в Past Perfect, а после offer ставится to-инфинитив.

prompt: A tired traveller stopped Jack at the train station. She asked if he (can / to carry) her large bag up the steps. Jack agreed (to lift) it to the top platform. She warned him (not / to hurt) his back.
explanation_ru: В вопросе can меняется на could, после agree нужен to-инфинитив, а после warn при запрете используется not to + глагол.

prompt: Sunny weather put everyone in a good mood. Hana suggested (to hold) a small picnic in the park on Sunday. Liam offered (to bake) some cheese rolls for the group. Hana also asked him (to invite) his younger brother.
explanation_ru: После suggest используется герундий (holding), а после offer и ask someone ставится to-инфинитив.

prompt: Grace phoned me before dinner. I told her that I (to paint) a funny birthday card for our dad. She asked what picture I (to draw) on the front. I begged her (not / to tell) him before the party.
explanation_ru: Оба действия происходили в момент разговора, поэтому Present Continuous переходит в Past Continuous, а после beg используется not to.

prompt: Stormy winds delayed several flights across the region. Ivan asked Kasia whether she (to confirm) their flight time for the next morning. She replied that the airline (to update) the screen right then. Ivan advised her (to sleep) a little longer instead of rushing.
explanation_ru: Вопрос о результате (Present Perfect) сдвигается в had confirmed, процесс в тот момент — в was updating, а совет после advise требует to-инфинитива.

prompt: Packing for the weekend trip, Olga turned to Pavel with a worried look. She asked him if he (to book) the guesthouse room the day before. Pavel admitted (to forget) about it during a busy afternoon at work. Olga immediately told him (to phone) the guesthouse before all the rooms sold out.
explanation_ru: Past Simple переходит в Past Perfect (had booked), после admit нужен герундий (forgetting), а после tell someone — to-инфинитив.

prompt: Returning a faulty toaster took longer than Mateo expected. The shop assistant asked whether he (to store) his paper receipts in a folder at home. Mateo apologised for (to tear) the paper one by mistake. The assistant advised him (to scan) receipts on his phone in future.
explanation_ru: Обычное действие в вопросе (Present Simple) сдвигается в Past Simple (stored), после предлога for идёт герундий, а после advise — to-инфинитив.

prompt: Wandering around the narrow lanes of York, Yusuf stopped near a stone bridge. He asked Rina if she (to recognise) that quiet street. She replied that they (to pass) the exact same corner twice before. Yusuf suggested (to ask) a postal worker for directions.
explanation_ru: Глагол состояния recognise сдвигается в Past Simple, более ранний опыт — в Past Perfect, а после suggest требуется герундий.

prompt: My phone battery died halfway to Edinburgh. Earlier, I had asked Oscar whether he (will / to pack) a spare power bank for the journey. He assured me that he (to charge) it fully the night before. Sadly, it was sitting neatly on his kitchen table.
explanation_ru: После глаголов в прошедшем времени will сдвигается в would, а прошлое действие (the night before) передаётся через Past Perfect.

prompt: Blue skies fooled almost everyone at the office that morning. Sean asked Tessa why (she / to carry) a thick winter coat in warm weather. She warned him (not / to trust) the morning sunshine. Sean laughed, though he regretted not listening later.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе используется прямой порядок слов (she was carrying), а предупреждение после warn строится с not to.

prompt: Rainy weekends always made our flatmates restless. Soren suggested (to visit) the interactive science museum on Saturday. Uma wondered how much (the tickets / to cost) for students. Soren explained that entry was free and offered (to reserve) a time slot online.
explanation_ru: После suggest нужен герундий (visiting), в косвенном вопросе сохраняется прямой порядок слов (the tickets cost), а после offer идёт to-инфинитив.

prompt: A delivery slip lay under Wei's front door after work. His flatmate asked him what (he / to order) online. Wei promised (to collect) the heavy box on Friday afternoon. His flatmate warned him (not / to park) on the double yellow lines outside the post office.
explanation_ru: Косвенный вопрос о предшествующем заказе требует прямого порядка слов и Past Perfect, promise — to-инфинитива, а warn — not to.

prompt: Before our club hike in Wales, the coach checked everyone's gear. She asked me which trainers (I / to wear) on the rocky trail. I admitted that I (still / to dry) my old boots near the radiator. The coach advised me (to buy) thick wool socks before departure.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе порядок слов прямой (I was wearing), процесс в момент речи уходит в was still drying, а после advise идёт to-инфинитив.

prompt: Sitting in the bright studio lobby, Yara chatted with the receptionist. She mentioned that her older sister (to design) websites on the third floor. The receptionist smiled and asked if Yara (to visit) the building before. Then she invited her (to sit) by the window with a cup of tea.
explanation_ru: Постоянный факт после mentioned обычно сдвигается в designed (допустимо и designs), опыт до момента речи передаётся через had visited, а после invite стоит to-инфинитив.

prompt: Impressed by the sharp portraits on screen, Nikos noticed the classic camera hanging round Jonas's neck. He asked Jonas who (to lend) him such a reliable piece of equipment. Jonas explained that his uncle still (to shoot) black-and-white photos with a second one. He added that his uncle had made him promise (not / to scratch) the glass lens.
explanation_ru: Вопрос к подлежащему о прошлом действии уходит в Past Perfect (had lent), регулярное действие сдвигается в shot, а отрицательное обещание строится с not to.

prompt: Pouring rain forced Imani back into the café where she had eaten lunch the day before. She asked the waiter whether anyone (to notice) a dark green umbrella beside the corner table. The waiter denied (to see) one near the window, though he remembered a green umbrella by the door. Before returning it, however, he asked her (to describe) the wooden handle.
explanation_ru: Прошедшее событие в вопросе переходит в had noticed, глагол deny требует герундия (seeing), а просьба после ask someone — to-инфинитива.

prompt: Boarding the crowded express train to Bath, Kabir stood beside seat 14B with his ticket in hand. The guard noticed his hesitation and asked who (to occupy) his reserved place. Kabir explained that the sleepy passenger refused (to show) his booking confirmation. Moments later, the guard insisted on (to inspect) both tickets and moved the man to coach D.
explanation_ru: Present Perfect в вопросе (who has occupied) сдвигается в had occupied, после refuse идёт to-инфинитив, а после insist on — герундий.

prompt: Daria stayed at her desk long after the rest of the office went home. Her director phoned to ask if she (still / to edit) the quarterly report that evening. Daria promised (to upload) the final version before midnight. Her director thanked her and suggested (to come) in after lunch the next day.
explanation_ru: Продолжающееся действие в вопросе переходит в Past Continuous (was still editing), после promise стоит to-инфинитив, а после suggest — герундий.

prompt: Over coffee in the courtyard, my new neighbour asked me how (I / to reach) the city centre from our quiet estate. I admitted (to cycle) along the canal path only in dry weather. I also warned her (not / to rely) on the number twelve bus during rush hour. She thanked me and wrote down the route.
explanation_ru: В косвенном вопросе порядок слов прямой без do (I reached), после admit используется герундий, а после warn при отрицании — not to.

prompt: Preparing for our flatwarming dinner, we bumped into our downstairs neighbour on the stairs. She politely asked how many guests (we / to invite) for the evening. I assured her that only six quiet friends (to arrive) around eight. I also apologised for (to play) loud music while we unpacked boxes earlier.
explanation_ru: Вопрос о сделанных приглашениях сдвигается в we had invited, планы на вечер — в were arriving/would arrive, а после apologised for нужен герундий.

prompt: Interviewing the village postmaster for a local magazine, Quinn opened her notebook beside the counter. She asked him how long (he / to live) in that quiet valley. He smiled and remarked that neighbours still (to greet) all visitors by name. Before she left, he insisted on (to show) her a box of faded street photographs.
explanation_ru: Вопрос с how long переходит в прямой порядок слов и Past Perfect (he had lived), привычка жителей допускает greeted/greet, а после insisted on нужен герундий.

prompt: Malik wanted to brighten the living room. He said that he ___ those yellow curtains the next day.
options: will hang
would hang
hangs
would hung
explanation_ru: После said глагол will переходит в would + начальная форма глагола (would hang); оставлять will или ставить прошедшую форму hung после would ошибочно.

prompt: An empty biscuit tin sat on the office desk. When I asked about it, Felipe finally admitted ___ my last chocolate biscuit the day before.
options: to eat
that he eats
eating
for eating
explanation_ru: Глагол admit требует герундия (admitted eating), а не инфинитива to eat и не предлога for.

prompt: Arriving late at the crowded seaside hotel, Javier asked the night porter ___ his rented car safely near the main entrance.
options: where could he park
where he can park
if where he could park
where he could park
explanation_ru: В специальном косвенном вопросе порядок слов прямой, can сдвигается в could, а лишний союз if перед where не ставится.

prompt: Fiona smiled and told her brother: “My friend will lend us her car for the weekend.” Which sentence reports this later?
options: Fiona told her brother that her friend would lend them her car for the weekend.
Fiona told her brother that my friend will lend us her car for the weekend.
Fiona told her brother that her friend will lend them her car for the weekend.
Fiona told her brother that her friend would lend us her car for the weekend.
explanation_ru: При передаче слов третьего лица меняются и глагол (will → would), и оба местоимения (my → her, us → them).

prompt: Between lessons, Rohan asked Zara: “Who is helping you with the posters today? Don't stay late.” Which report is completely correct?
options: Rohan asked Zara who was helping her with the posters today and told her to not stay late.
Rohan asked Zara who was helping her with the posters that day and told her not to stay late.
Rohan asked Zara who is helping her with the posters that day and told her not to stay late.
Rohan asked Zara who was she helping with the posters that day and told her not to stay late.
explanation_ru: Нужны сразу три изменения: is helping → was helping (прямой порядок слов), today → that day и правильный порядок not to stay.

prompt: Locking up the tennis club, Henrik asked the cleaner: “Whose gym bag have you found here? Please lock it in reception.” Which report is accurate?
options: Henrik asked the cleaner whose gym bag had she found there and asked her to lock it in reception.
Henrik asked the cleaner whose gym bag she has found here and asked her locking it in reception.
Henrik asked the cleaner whose gym bag she had found there and asked her to lock it in reception.
Henrik asked the cleaner whose gym bag she had found here and asked that she lock it in reception.
explanation_ru: В вопросе нужен прямой порядок слов и Past Perfect (she had found), слово here меняется на there, а вежливая просьба передаётся через asked her to lock.
